summary: Accelerate agent storage health and provider inventory

delivery.outcome: Accelerate diagnostics by parallelizing agent storage SQLite integrity checks and providing native multi-threaded acceleration in Rust for snapshot health and provider inventory while retaining verified 100% Python fallback.
nonGoals: No external C library dependencies or system package additions
No changes to public CLI interface or JSON diagnostic schema contracts

architecture.decision: Use bounded thread pool execution for SQLite integrity checks in Python to eliminate the single-threaded 2.5s bottleneck; add parallel multi-threaded audit in snapshot.rs for snapshot health; add native provider inventory scanning in snapshot.rs for fast Codex/Claude session enumeration with full Python fallback.
architecture.rollback: Revert commit on main; retain previous diagnostics release.

validation.evidence: Bounded parallel SQLite integrity checks preserve exact error classification ('ok', 'corrupted', 'unavailable', 'missing') and sequential parity.
Multi-threaded native snapshot health audit matches Python fallback and preserves security boundaries.
Native provider inventory acceleration matches Python output structure and falls back safely on any IO or format error.
All tests pass without regression; governance clean; publication via OneDev and independent Validator.
